title: Xenocontendi Revived X Fresh Animations
description: Fresh Animations Compatible Add-on for Xenocontendi Revived
body:
[Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) by [FreshLX](https://modrinth.com/user/FreshLX) working with Xenocontendi Revived x16.

This resource pack allows Xenocontendi Revived mobs to work with [FA](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations).

You have to place it above Fresh Animations in the resource pack list:

![Resource pack load order](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1af4b8cee132c05fd66d76823133c1ceb1e68a17.png)

**Also check out the [Xenocontendi Revived x FA: Player Extensions add-on pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/xenocontendi-revived-x-fresh-animations-player-extension) too!**
